# Artimas 26-27

> Artimas 26-27 is the flagship technical and creative festival organized by AiMSA (AI & ML Student Association) at the Department of Computer Science & Engineering (AI & ML), Pimpri Chinchwad College of Engineering (PCCOE), Pune, India. The festival theme is "The Four Yugas Converge" — a mythological journey through the four cosmic ages of Hindu philosophy: Satyuga, Tretayuga, Dwaparyuga, and Kalyuga.

## About

- **Organized by**: AiMSA (AI & ML Student Association), CSE (AI & ML) Department
- **College**: Pimpri Chinchwad College of Engineering (PCCOE), Pune, Maharashtra, India
- **Dates**: October 9–11, 2026
- **Website**: https://artimas.aimsapccoe.in
- **Theme**: The Four Yugas Converge — Hindu mythology themed festival

## Events

### Satyuga (The Age of Truth & Purity)
- **Pixel Perfect** — UI/UX Design Competition
- **Datathon** — Data Science & Analytics Challenge

### Tretayuga (The Age of Duty & Sacrifice)
- **Prompt Relay** — AI Prompt Engineering Relay
- **Brandathon** — Brand Building & Marketing Challenge

### Dwaparyuga (The Age of Strategy & Conflict)
- **Kurukshetra (CTF)** — Capture The Flag Cybersecurity Challenge
- **Houdini Heist (Chakravyuh)** — Escape Room / Puzzle Solving

### Kalyuga (The Age of Innovation & Disruption)
- **HackMatrix** — 24-Hour Hackathon (in collaboration with GFG PCCOE)
- **Among Us (Mayavi)** — Real-Life Among Us Game
